# Deployment Regulations
These are non-modifiable SOP's that cannot be changed unless approved by a member of Provost.
- Medical, Requisitions and CIC must have at least one member of their department on the ship/installation for any other members of their department to deploy. - Deployment of staff should never be done if it would leave their department understaffed. - IO, EO, Engineering Technicians, Synthetics and General Infantry are the only permitted personnel to deploy before a FOB has been established and secure.
## Command Staff - Commanders may deploy to the FOB and only to the frontline with permission from High Command. ([italic]OOC: Ahelp for staff aproval[/italic]) - Executive Officers may deploy to the FOB and only to the frontline with permission from High Command. ([italic]OOC: Ahelp for staff aproval[/italic]) - Staff Officers may deploy one person to the FOB with XO/CO permission and never to the frontline. - Advisors may deploy to the FOB freely and only to the frontline with XO/CO permission to assist fresh leadership.
## Department Heads - CMO & CMP may only deploy to FOB if no one else is available to perform their duties. - LO may only deploy to FOB to perform their duties only if their department is being manned by another member of their department. - IO may deploy freely to the FOB and the Frontline only to collect intelligence. They should avoid direct engagement. - EO may deploy freely to the FOB.
## Medical Staff - Nurses & Doctors may only deploy to FOB with permission from the CMO or XO/CO.
## Logistic Technicians - Logistic Technicians may only deploy if their department is manned by another member of their department for delivering ressuplies only to the FOB. - They may utilize drones for deployment of resupplies to the frontline.
## Engineering Technicians - Follows EO deployment regulations.
## Military Police - Military Police may deploy to the FOB with permission of the CMP or XO/CO
## Flight Crew - Dropship Pilots & Dropship Crew Chiefs may only deploy to the FOB for transport of personnel.
## Synthetics - May be deployed to the FOB or Frontline depending on orders.
## General Infantry All listed personnel below are covered as general infantry and are expected to deploy. - Squad Leaders - Fireteam Leaders - Drone Operators - Weapon Specialists - Vehicle Crewmen - Vehicle Commanders - Hospital Corpsmen - Radio Traffic Operators - Automatic Riflemen - Combat Technicians - Riflemen
